method: Sequential fresh servers in ABBA order. Each receives the last eight archive prompt IDs for an eight-token warmup, then an uncached 912-token greedy handover request. Default prefill supplies ID 1. Timed blocks use known gold prefixes and evaluate all remaining logits, synchronize, then take argmax. Width 8 ends with seven rows. Per-position quantities pool totals over 126 positions per width. The profiler was enabled after prefill. No draft model, acceptance or rollback.

interpretation.source: Demand and speculative source payload bytes count successful reads including page-cache hits. No range reads in these blocks. process_disk_bytes is process-wide macOS disk accounting under uncontrolled filesystem cache conditions. Distinct (layer, expert) pairs are counted separately in every block.
interpretation.gpu: Union of Metal graph command-buffer execution intervals after submission. Includes gaps within a buffer. GPU interval timestamps obtained after normal block synchronization. Expert command buffers are tagged while executing the expert callback. These are graph GPU times, not kernel hardware cycles.
interpretation.waits: Union of host spans blocked for a demanded slice, an early read, or a synchronous source read. ready_over_gpu reports intersection with measured graph GPU intervals. Host fence time is separate. Profile counters are nested and cannot be added to the disjoint wall partition.
interpretation.partition: Block elapsed time through argmax. Unions clipped to the block, with precedence expert GPU, other graph GPU, readiness, acquire, expert fence, expert submit, other expert callback, remainder. part_ fields sum to wall. Snapshots and trace printing are outside the window.
interpretation.clean: Clean comparison excludes all source/GPU instrumentation. Timed target + argmax positions/s on prerecorded candidates is an upper bound for prediction-dependent decoding on this fixture.

expert_config: All four startup logs reported auto architecture=qwen4exp compact=1 recycle=1 reclaim=1 FP32=1 address_batch=1 priority_readers=1 prefetch=8 ready=4 optional_bytes=59299648.
findings: Width eight amortizes outer Metal execution across positions and reduces total source bytes while increasing synchronous exposure to demanded reads. Recycle is already on. Count size-class misses, pinned/retiring entries and released spares to locate the remaining fresh allocations. Compare a bounded reuse improvement and an earlier exact-demand pipeline under the same cap. No end-to-end acceleration for either proposed change was measured.
trace_format: RUN label, then B first_input_offset start_ns end_ns demand_bytes speculative_bytes range_bytes route_assignments distinct_layer_experts layer_calls. A/X/W/S are host acquire/callback/completion wait/submit, Q/P/R are demanded queue/early task/sync read. Each has start_ns end_ns. G/M are expert/outer Metal buffers with start_ns end_ns status (4=completed). E ends a block.
